verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a payments platform that ships terminal software, SDKs and an MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting or mechanism for opting out. The omnichannel shopper recognition material concerns identifying shoppers, not opting out of the product's own telemetry, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
